defects.summary: The 'refused before the launch' arm of S5.6.7 does not go through the service: it builds QuestionRowLaunch, RowLaunchInput and the admission by hand, and no junction is ever made in it, so its never-invoked-recorder assertion is vacuous (deviation 56 records this honestly).

The private Scopes class and StandIn() are copied verbatim from AKimiConsultationScenarioTests (and copied again in AKimiQuestionRowTests), so there are now three copies where one shared test helper would do.
For 'the scratch repository unchanged', S5.5.1 relies only on the check's own answered state and the canary's 'not-attempted'; it does not assert that the scratch repository was left as it was.
The S5.6.5 test finds the home with the literal "--home", while the new check tests use AcpWords.HomeFlag.
Deviation 60 and the status line add process notes outside the stories (which model built it, a review I cannot check, a redacted experiment branch name), and they make the status line much longer.

summary: Every decision of E5.5 and E5.6 is delivered. The planner arm (Snapshot for disk, Scratch for none, no flags), the three kimi rows (unconfined, unconfined, unmeasured) with correctly cited RESULTS sections, the vectors, the hand-written Runtimes list, the regenerated TS table and the refusal of a plan with any flag (Flags or Leading) all match the spec, and all 12 scenarios exist and pass with no new failures. The findings are only minor: duplicated test helpers, one S5.6.7 arm that bypasses the service and whose recorder check proves nothing, and process notes in the plan's deviation list that do not belong to the stories.
